data.eligibility_information:
Eligibility Criteria 
Qualification:  Candidates pursuing Full Time Graduation or Post Graduation 
Courses recognized by a state or Private university in Design with 
specialization from (Interaction Design, Graphic Design, 
Advertising Animation and Film Making, Visual Design, AR/VR, 
Creative Education / Human Centred Design, User Experience 
Design, Visual Communication, Product Design, Communication 
Design, Gaming Animation) from the batch of 2026 are eligible. 
Percentage 

Minimum aggregate (aggregate of all subjects in all semesters) 
marks of 50% or above in the in each of Class Xth, Class XIIth, 
Diploma (if applicable), Graduation and/or Post Graduation 
examination which includes successful completion of final 
year/semester. 

Backlogs & Extended Education Upto one active backlog at the time of appearing for the TCS selection process is permitted. However, it is mandatory that the course is completed within the stipulated time duration without any backlogs at the time of joining TCS, if selected. 
 
Extended education would not be considered as eligible. 
Gaps/ Break It is mandatory for students to declare gaps in education, if any in the TCS Application Form. The overall academic gap should not exceed 24 months until the highest qualification. Relevant document proof, as applicable, will be checked for gaps in 
education.
  
Course Type 
Only full-time courses will be considered (part time/correspondence courses will not be considered). Candidates who have completed their Secondary and/or Senior Secondary course from NIOS (National Institute of Open Schooling) are also eligible to apply if the other courses are full-time. 

Work Experience No candidate with more than 3 years of prior work experience would be eligible to apply.  

Age Limit Minimum 18 years and Maximum 28 years.
data.additional_information:
Junior Designer

Profile:
 As Junior Designer, you will be involved in some key phases
of the design process, assisting senior members of the team
as needed. Your role will be to support other senior
designers and creative leads with the design work by
creating deliverables and assets, whilst being exposed to the
latest ways of working within the industry.
We work in cross-functional teams so you will need to
demonstrate experience or an interest in visual, UI/UX,
animation design, along with the practical & technical
knowledge to support ideas.
Our designers are enthusiastic and detail oriented, able to
produce outstanding visual design work for a variety of
projects. They are conceptual thinkers, problem solvers,
collaborative, technically aware and able to manage
multiple projects with ease — those being qualities you
should also strive for.

Responsibilities:
• Create high quality deliverables ready for
implementation or that require minimum oversight, from
either presentations to final digital product application
• Efficiently produce design, UI/UX, creative work from
discussion, concepts and wireframes across multiple
media and digital products
• Have confidence when presenting your work to your
team, and the studio.
• Can work independently and in a team, to take on board
direction and action effectively
• Have a 'Can-do' attitude that always delivers on time and
to the highest quality
• Work with motion designers and creative technologists
to ensure effectiveness and feasibility of your designs

Preferences:
• A portfolio demonstrating form and function across a
variety product
• Good understanding of design fundamentals (type,
space, form)
• Good knowledge of Design Tools such as Figma and
Adobe CC
 • Self-motivated, enthusiastic, with excellent time
management
• The ability to be able to communicate your ideas clearly
• Take on constructive criticism and use this to enhance
deliverables
• A quick learner possessing a positive 'can do' attitude
